about.intro_content: Prof. Min Zheng is a Professor, Chief Physician and Doctoral Supervisor in gynecologic oncology at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou, with rich experience in Da Vinci robotic surgery for gynecologic tumors.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Zheng completed her MD at the Medical College of Zurich University and Medical College of Bern University, Switzerland, with additional visiting scholar training in the USA. She has published more than 40 research papers examining the incidence of gynecologic tumors and chemotherapy resistance, and has led novel combination drug trials for endometrial and ovarian cancer, including a phase II trial of sintilimab plus anlotinib for recurrent or advanced endometrial cancer and a phase Ib trial of anlotinib combined with TQB2450 for platinum-resistant ovarian cancer.

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Min Zheng

items.question: Does Prof. Min Zheng accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to gynecologic cancer at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Zheng's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Zheng specialises in the diagnosis and treatment of gynecologic tumors, particularly Da Vinci robotic surgery for cervical and ovarian cancer, and novel combination drug trials.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: Is Prof. Zheng involved in clinical trials for advanced gynecologic cancer?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Zheng has led phase II/Ib trials combining immunotherapy and targeted therapy for recurrent endometrial cancer and platinum-resistant ovarian cancer.

items.question: Does Prof. Zheng perform robotic surgery for gynecologic cancer?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Zheng has rich experience performing Da Vinci robotic surgery for gynecologic tumors, offering a minimally invasive surgical option for eligible patients.
